newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt to buy stake in Russian bank in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt to buy stake in Russian bank in Dec.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank SA will sign an agreement on purchasing a stake in a Russian bank in the Kaliningrad enclave in mid-December, the bank's spokesman said on Wednesday.
"In mid December the agreement on buying a stake in one of the banks in Kaliningrad enclave will be signed," Marcin Olkowicz told Reuters.
He declined to give any details, but said the bank would release more information in the next few days.

Earlier the bank said it was interested in buying a controlling stake in a Russian bank. It said it was interested mainly in the Kaliningrad region but said it was also taking into account investment in Moscow.
Kredyt Bank currently has representative offices in Vilnius and Kaliningrad and holds a 13.3-percent stake in the Kiev International Bank.
It also has Lithuania's central bank permission to establish a branch in the Baltic state.
